text:
Maria: Heads up — after the slice audit, I'm proposing a 'gating' layer between enrichers and the request-router to reduce shared-state surface. Short plan below.

Aj: +1. high-level timeline?

Maria: 3 phases: 1) interface flags + shim (2 weeks), 2) move hotpath code to modules behind gate + smoke (4 weeks), 3) tranche rollouts + observability (2 weeks).

Priya: will product be impacted? any API changes consumers should know?

Maria: no external API change. internal telemetry tag `module_gate` will appear. We'll coordinate deprecations if we remove adapters later.

Carl: make sure rollout has a circuit-breaker default and a fallback to monolith. otherwise we'll get pager storms. suggest feature-flag + runtime config.

Maria: agreed. example snippet for runtime config:
```
module_gating:
  enrichers:
    default: enabled
    fast_path: gradual
```

Aj: can eng-ml help with hotpath perf tests? need perf baselines before toggles.

Priya: product support helps with canary cohorts. i'll own the rollout doc + customer comms.

Maria: ok i'll open an RFC PR with the timeline + rollback playbook. tagging @Carl @Aj for early review :hand: 

linus-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/feature-gates spike at 2026-04-05T18:00Z :rocket:

Carl: quick note — add SLO smoke: 99th latency, error-rate threshold 0.5% and token-cost delta monitor.

Maria: noted. thanks all.
